d.ctx: The expert offers their phone number to the user. The user agrees to take it.
d.j: The speaker is explicitly offering their phone number to continue contact outside the app.

d.ctx: The expert begins dictating their phone number. The user listens and prepares to note it down.
d.j: The speaker is providing their phone number to the user to facilitate contact outside the app.

d.seg: సిక్స్ త్రీ జీరో టూ ఎయిట్ డబల్ సెవెన్ వన్ ఎయిట్ జీరో
d.ctx: The expert completes dictating the phone number. The user acknowledges the information.
d.j: The speaker is providing their phone number to the user to facilitate contact outside the app.

d.ctx: The expert instructs the user to message them on WhatsApp using the number provided. The user confirms they will do so.
d.j: The speaker is proposing to move the conversation to WhatsApp, a named external app.
